need: A fresh copy of the template ships a layout plan (lockstep.yaml) for its starter files, while copier update of an older copy does not add one.

searched.query: layout rows, lockstep layout, lockstep init
searched.found: Layout rows, the edit hook and the whole-tree check exist and are used by AES itself; only the template lacked a lockstep.yaml.

searched.query: render a file on copy but not on update
searched.found: _skip_if_exists keeps an existing file but still adds a missing one on update; _exclude evaluated with _copier_operation excludes a file on update only (tried on copier 9.19.1).

candidates.name: copier _skip_if_exists
candidates.covers: Keeps a file a copy already has on update.
candidates.misses: Still creates the file on update of a copy that never had it, which is the case to avoid.
candidates.reason: It protects only a file that already exists; the copier-native _exclude with _copier_operation is used instead.

gap: A template lockstep.yaml.jinja, cog blocks in the starter files, one _exclude entry, AGENTS.md text and one Makefile line.
